Entry Granaries of the Reach The wheat fields, orchards, and irrigation canals of the Reach provide food for many parts of the Seven Kingdoms. While Highgarden's vassals built a reputation as rich and shipowners and grain merchants profited, distant towns discovered in lean years that food from rich areas did not automatically flow to starvation. Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.
